description: Llama-based open-weight TTS model for 23-language speech synthesis with one-shot voice cloning from short reference audio and automatic word-alignment support.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated audio tokens per chunk. When omitted, OuteTTS estimates a safe value from each chunk.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Sampling temperature; default 0.4 for cloning, otherwise model config default.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k sampling; default 40 for cloning, otherwise model config default.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus sampling in (0, 1]; default 0.9 for cloning, otherwise model config default.

request.name: min_p
request.description: Minimum probability relative to the best token; default 0.05 for cloning, otherwise model config default.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampling seed; cloning defaults to 4099 for native weights and 42 for quantized weights.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript matching the reference voice audio for voice cloning.

request.name: reference_language
request.description: Language code used to align the reference transcript; default en.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum UTF-8 codepoints per long-form text chunk; default 256. Chunks are split further when required by max_tokens or context budget.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework long-form text chunking mode; default word_budget.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Language-model weight storage type. Quantized CUDA voice cloning is expanded to F32 in memory for generation correctness.

session.name: llama_weight_context_mb
session.description: Language-model weight context size in MiB; default 4096.

session.name: constant_context_mb
session.description: Language-model constant tensor context size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: dac_weight_context_mb
session.description: DAC decoder weight context size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: dac_graph_arena_mb
session.description: DAC decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: aligner_path
session.description: Optional Qwen3 Forced Aligner override. Cloning automatically uses the aligner embedded in a standalone OuteTTS GGUF when present.

session.name: reference_cache_slots
session.description: Prepared reference-profile cache slots; default 1, set 0 to disable.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release cached-step and aligner runtime state after use; default false.
